evidence_corrections.source_order: The initial R4 packet helper rejected differently ordered manifest rows before writing a packet. All 7,156 unique path/hash rows matched. R5 compares complete rows sorted by path; product source and test results were unchanged.
evidence_corrections.cleanup: The first independent fixture cleanup receipts contained empty process maps after a PowerShell conversion error and are invalid. Each lane has a corrected R2 receipt using the ownership manifest as a Hashtable.
evidence_corrections.screenshots: The corrected R2 visual review supersedes an inaccurate generic description in the unpublished R1 review: suspend displays Resume agent session; it does not display the stop-stage recovery restriction. Five actual screenshots were reviewed; the lifecycle driver produced none.
evidence_corrections.publication_whitespace: Publication R1 passed documentation but failed Git whitespace validation on 11 public log copies. The initial normalization helper handled LF only and exited 1 without changing files. R2 removes final blank log lines and normalizes public text copies from CRLF to LF so recorded public hashes describe the actual Git blob bytes. All original logs, failed copies, failed exits and validation remain retained; product source and recorded test results are unchanged.
